data.name: Add comment to discussion
data.evaluateGuide:
Adds a comment to a Notion discussion using the supplied comment payload. Use it to contribute feedback or conversation to an existing discussion.
Use for: Add discussion feedback, post a comment, continue a conversation
Not supported: Page creation, database queries, searching content

data.name: Query a database
data.evaluateGuide:
Queries rows in a specified Notion database and returns matching results. Use it to retrieve database entries for filtering, reporting, or automation.
Use for: List database entries, filter records, retrieve matching pages
Not supported: Creating pages, full-content search, adding comments

data.name: Create a page
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a new page in Notion from the supplied page payload. Use it to add content to a parent page or database.
Use for: Create a page, add a database record, publish structured content
Not supported: Updating pages, querying databases, searching content

data.name: Search
data.description: Searches all parent or child pages and databases that have been shared with the integration.
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches parent and child pages and databases shared with the integration. Use it to locate accessible Notion resources by search criteria.
Use for: Find pages, find databases, locate shared content
Not supported: Creating content, querying database rows, token inspection

data.name: Create Notion page in database
data.description:
Let's iterate over Typeform responses and create a corresponding page on Notion.
If you modified the Notion database, like renaming columns or changing column type, this request might fail.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a Notion page corresponding to a Typeform response, typically within a configured database. Database schema changes may cause the operation to fail.
Use for: Create response pages, add Typeform records, populate a Notion database
Not supported: Reading responses, searching pages, updating existing pages

data.name: Get parent page in Notion
data.description: Easily find all the pages on your Notion workspace and identify on which page you want to add the Book Recommendations database.
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches Notion resources to help identify a parent page for new content. Use it to locate pages shared with the integration.
Use for: Find a parent page, locate workspace pages, identify a destination
Not supported: Creating pages, querying databases, retrieving page contents

data.name: Introspect
data.description: Returns information about an access token.
data.evaluateGuide:
Returns information about a Notion access token. Use it to inspect token-associated details and verify token identity.
Use for: Inspect an access token, identify token details, validate token context
Not supported: Searching content, creating pages, managing database entries

data.name: POST /append-blocks
data.description:
Appends prebuilt Notion blocks directly to a page. Use this when you already have Notion block JSON (e.g., from /convert or another system). Includes intelligent planning, batching, and retry logic.
Skips Markdown conversion and directly processes your block array. Supports complex structures including tables, synced blocks, and nested children.
Request: { blocks: array, notionToken: string, pageId: string, after?: string }
Response 200: { status: 'success', data: { totalBlocks: number, requestCount: numb
data.evaluateGuide:
Appends prebuilt Notion block JSON directly to a page, with batching and retry handling. Use it when block content is already structured and should be added without Markdown conversion.
Use for: Append blocks, add tables, add nested content
Not supported: Markdown conversion, page creation, database querying
